description: SimBench (-) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by University of Kassel (UoK); TU Dortmund (TUD); RWTH Aachen (RWTHA); Fraunhofer IWES (IWES). The main goal of the SimBench project is the development of a benchmark data set for solutions for defined use cases in the field of network analysis, network planning and network operation. Coverage: Europe; attention to Germany. Time resolution: annual, hour, 15 min. Spatial resolution: continents, national states. Software: pandapower/python; digsilent powerfactory; integral. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.

outputs: The SimBench dataset, as the main result of the project, is fully and publicly available in the “Download” area of this website. The dataset contains electrical parameters for the static modelling of electric grids and covers voltage levels from low to extra-high voltage. All 13 basic grids can be interconnected and are available in three variants (future scenarios). Also integrated are time series in 15-minute resolution for a whole year as well as predefined study cases. https://simbench.de/en/download/datasets/
